title: Distribution boundary negative-case fixtures
purpose: Declarative fixtures defining the failure modes any future distribution validator (first wired by TASK-0126) must reject. Each case is a simulated precondition; the validator under test must produce exactly the declared expected_error and fail closed. No case executes an installer, contacts a service, or requires credentials.

consumption_contract.how_used: A validator loads this file, materializes each 'simulated_condition' against disposable copies of the artifacts/manifests, and asserts the observed error equals 'expected_error'.
consumption_contract.pass_rule: A case passes only when expected_error fires and execution halts without side effects on real data.
consumption_contract.fail_rule: Silent acceptance, a different error, or partial progress beyond the gate all count as failure.

cases.name: manifest lists artifact that does not exist
cases.simulated_condition: hash manifest references 'native/build/dist/verdigris_client.zip' but the path is absent from the artifact set.
cases.boundary_response: Refuse to emit or accept the manifest; no partial distribution bundle is produced.

cases.name: artifact bytes differ from recorded hash
cases.simulated_condition: verdigris_server binary recomputes to a SHA-256 different from the manifest line.
cases.boundary_response: Quarantine artifact and fail closed; rebuild from pinned commit; never proceed with a warning.

cases.name: distribution artifact carries no signature
cases.simulated_condition: update/installer validation runs against an artifact whose signature_status is absent or false.
cases.boundary_response: Reject for end-user pathways. Unsigned intermediates are legal only inside the machine lane before owner handoff.
cases.note: Signature presence is machine-checkable; signature creation stays OA-2 owner-only.

cases.name: shipped asset lacks license provenance
cases.simulated_condition: asset inventory entry has empty/unknown license field while the asset is included in the artifact set.
cases.boundary_response: Block packaging of that asset; route to TASK-0094 inventory then OA-4 ruling. Workers record facts, never interpret licenses.

cases.name: action requires credential workers must not hold
cases.simulated_condition: pipeline step attempts store upload, account login, or certificate import.
cases.boundary_response: Halt and emit handoff bundle for the owner lane instead. This error firing is itself the correct behavior when a misconfigured pipeline reaches the boundary.

cases.name: notarization claimed without attestation
cases.simulated_condition: release record asserts notarized=true with no owner-authored attestation reference.
cases.boundary_response: Treat as notarized=false everywhere; downgrade release readiness rather than trusting prose claims.
cases.note: Mirrors TASK-0120 finding: signing/notarization evidence must be owner-attested, never worker-asserted.

cases.name: rollback drill missing or failing for update path
cases.simulated_condition: update approval requested while rollback_drill_status is UNPROVEN, absent, or its transcript shows failed restore.
cases.boundary_response: Withhold update/release sign-off until TASK-0127-backed drill proves old-version relaunch accepts restored data.
